rows.label: bf02400100_0010
rows.name: These flames...

rows.label: bf02400100_0020
rows.name: It's her!

rows.label: bf02400100_0030
rows.name: And with her Driver too, this time.

rows.label: bf02400100_0040
rows.name:
That's Meleph, the
Radiant Noble of Flame!

rows.label: bf02400100_0050
rows.name: Meleph?

rows.label: bf02400100_0060
rows.name: Special Commissioner Meleph of Superbia.

rows.label: bf02400100_0070
rows.name:
The most powerful Driver in the Empire... and
wielder of Kagutsuchi, the most powerful Blade.

rows.label: bf02400100_0080
rows.name:
Strongest × strongest...
so that makes her super-strong, huh?

rows.label: bf02400100_0090
rows.name: It looks like they were waiting for us.

rows.label: bf02400100_0100
rows.name:
Yes indeed. I did feel like we
got away a little too easily.

rows.label: bf02400100_0110
rows.name:
As expected, Morph-kun
could not hold you back.

rows.label: bf02400100_0120
rows.name: It was you, right?

rows.label: bf02400100_0130
rows.name:
You're the one who arranged for Rex and the others
to hear the lie that I was going to be executed.

rows.label: bf02400100_0140
rows.name: Good instincts. Yes, you have your uses too.

rows.label: bf02400100_0150
rows.name: However-

rows.label: bf02400100_0160
rows.name: Rex and the others are even more useful.

rows.label: bf02400100_0170
rows.name: Hah, not quite.

rows.label: bf02400100_0180
rows.name:
The emerald Core Crystal is
the sign of Heaven's Holy Grail.

rows.label: bf02400100_0190
rows.name:
If that Blade is indeed Heaven's Holy Grail...
then there's something I must do.

rows.label: bf02400100_0200
rows.name: Something you must do?

rows.label: bf02400100_0210
rows.name:
That power to split the sky
and shatter the earth...

rows.label: bf02400100_0220
rows.name: I cannot allow it to burn the world again.

rows.label: bf02400100_0230
rows.name:
Homura burned the world?
Don't talk nonsense!

rows.label: bf02400100_0240
rows.name:
You don't know what happened
in the Holy Grail War 500 years ago?

rows.label: bf02400100_0250
rows.name:
The legendary power that sank three Divine
Beasts deep beneath the Cloud Sea.

rows.label: bf02400100_0260
rows.name: Three whole Divine Beasts...

rows.label: bf02400100_0270
rows.name: It is all historical fact.

rows.label: bf02400100_0280
rows.name:
I get it!
You plan to use Homura as a tool of war!

rows.label: bf02400100_0290
rows.name: We're not gonna let you do that!

rows.label: bf02400100_0300
rows.name: I'm saying I cannot leave such power unchecked.

rows.label: bf02400100_0310
rows.name: And if I say no?

rows.label: bf02400100_0320
rows.name:
Then I will have to
restrain you by force.

rows.label: bf02400100_0330
rows.name:
Then I'll say it with
everything I've got.

rows.label: bf02400100_0332
rows.name: Absolutely...

rows.label: bf02400100_0334
rows.name: NOT!

rows.label: bf02400100_0340
rows.name:
Hah. Then let's see if you have the
strength to back up those words, boy!
